title: Curvature Sign Rigidity and Sharp Pointwise Pinching Thresholds
summary: We study connected Riemannian manifolds on which either the sectional curvature or the Ricci tensor is, at each point, strictly positive, strictly negative, or zero, and ask whether the two signs can coexist under pointwise pinching. A general support-rigidity theorem for positive semidefinite divergence-free symmetric tensors is the common analytic mechanism. For sectional curvature in dimension $n\ge 3$, any locally uniform positive lower bound for the absolute pointwise pinching ratio rules out a change of sign. With a fixed pinching constant $δ_0$, the flat set has no $C^1$ hypersurface…
